adds.title: Teresina City Council bathroom bill / Mayoral law - June 17, 2026 vote and July 30 signing
adds.summary: Teresina enacted a municipal law on bathroom use by trans women, approved June 17, 2026 and sanctioned July 30, 2026.

adds.title: Brazilian Supreme Federal Court decision - 2019
adds.summary: On 24 May 2019 a 6-of-11 majority of Brazil's Supreme Federal Court voted to criminalize transphobia as equivalent to racism punishable under Brazil's racism law until Congress passes specific LGBT-protection legislation, with remaining votes due 5 June, amid 141 LGBT killings in Brazil that year and 420 in 2018.

adds.title: Supreme Federal Court - 2019 nationwide gender identity discrimination ban
adds.summary: On 24 May 2019 a majority of Brazil's Supreme Federal Court (6 of 11 justices) voted to criminalize transphobia and homophobia as equivalent to racism, punishable under Brazil's racism law until Congress enacts specific LGBT-protection legislation.
